gate: G2 - DST correctness survives a timezone build step, and the build is idempotent
finding: G2 PREMISE FALSIFIED, AND REPLACED. ical.js 2.2.1 as published on npm ships NO VTIMEZONE data and NO generator: ICAL.TimezoneService.get("America/New_York") returns undefined on a fresh install, and ICAL.Timezone.get does not exist in 2.x. So there is nothing to rebuild in the sense the plan assumed; the data must be PRODUCED.
replacement: build:timezones generates a deterministic UTC-offset transition table for the 8 supported zones over 2020-2040 from the platform IANA database, frozen into src/domain/recurrence/ical.timezones.generated.js. Recurrence reads the pinned table, never the host tzdata, so a host tzdata update cannot silently change what a calendar shows.
idempotence: pnpm run build:timezones --check regenerates and fails on any byte difference; verified byte-identical across repeated runs. This replaces the plan git-diff test, which would depend on a clean git tree.
fixtures: 09:00 weekly across both 2026 US DST boundaries: local time held at 09:00, offsets {EST, EDT}, real gaps only 167/168/169 hours
all-day in America/Santiago, whose transition happens at midnight: 10 consecutive calendar dates, transition day measured at 23 hours
monthly on the 31st: months without a 31st are skipped, never spilled forward
RECURRENCE-ID overlay: exactly one patched occurrence, the other nine untouched, following occurrences unmoved, and a cancelled occurrence materialised even when the rule never generated it
refusalBehaviour: an instant outside the pinned horizon, or an unpinned zone, raises a typed error rather than guessing (binding rule 8)
